_comment: cobolget-schema lock/import manifest for the AWS CardDemo test suite. cobolget's native lockfile is modules-lock.json; this file is named tests/import.json per the AAP-mandated test plan but follows the cobolget lock schema. It pins the EXACT GCBLUnit source so every checkout vendors byte-identical framework code (a reproducibility guarantee for a financial-grade suite). Companion to tests/cobolget.json. RESOLUTION (review finding MA-09): the former 'https://cobolget.com/gcblunit' registry URL was unreachable (parked domain) and non-immutable; it is replaced by the immutable upstream Git commit recorded below. The vendored file tests/cobol-unit/gcblunit.cbl is a REWRITTEN GPL derivative of that upstream source (see its header MODIFICATION HISTORY), so TWO hashes are recorded for full auditability: 'upstreamSha256' is the SHA-256 of the pristine upstream gcblunit.cbl at the pinned commit (verifiable by re-fetching 'resolved' and hashing it), and 'vendoredSha256' is the SHA-256 of our committed derivative (verifiable with: sha256sum tests/cobol-unit/gcblunit.cbl). The two hashes intentionally DIFFER because the derivative is a deliberate rewrite, not a verbatim copy. LICENSE: GPL-2.0-or-later. UPDATE (review finding MA-19): explicit scope terminators (END-ADD/END-WRITE/END-COMPUTE) were added to the vendored derivative so it compiles warning-clean under -Wall -Wextra, under which the test build treats -Wterminator as fatal; this changed vendoredSha256 to the value recorded below (re-verify with: sha256sum tests/cobol-unit/gcblunit.cbl).
